key_insight: RoleFlow learns to adapt multi-agent collaboration structures by isolating the contribution of individual structural edits.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive coordination could reduce reliance on fixed agent workflows for mathematical reasoning, coding, and web interaction.
method: Refine collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits.
Synthesize new agent roles on demand.
Use SECPO to compare each edit with a no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and credit edit-specific tokens.
evidence_signal: Across seven benchmarks in four domains, RoleFlow reports the best average performance, exceeding the strongest competitor by 4.7 points and leading three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2–7.5 F1 points.
watch_item: Edit-versus-no-edit evaluations may add training cost; the abstract does not quantify this overhead.
paper_title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
